Subject: Unable to access POs — login error + missing tax form

Hi Jonas / Ben,

We're trying to review incoming POs this morning but our vendor account in your Coupa portal shows "Pending verification" and there are no POs visible. When I try to sign in I get an error that says "Token expired or invalid". I tried the link in the invite twice (desktop and mobile).

Also attached is the tax form we uploaded (crestline_taxform_v2.pdf). The portal UI indicates the tax form field is blank. Can you confirm whether the upload completed on your side or if there's a problem with the file?

We have an urgent PO (PO# 89123) awaiting acceptance — is there a manual override while this is being investigated?

Thanks,
Sarah Lim

Thanks for the heads up, Sarah. Sorry for the interruption — we'll get this sorted. Quick plan:

- Ben, can you take point on the Coupa side and validate whether the tax form landed in the verification queue?
- Laura, please standby in case we need a manual verification/unblock for PO# 89123 (customer facing).

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unable to access POs — login error + missing tax form

Hi Sarah — I dug into the verification queue this morning. Notes:

- Your tax form (crestline_taxform_v2.pdf) did arrive but failed automated parsing due to a scanned header layout our parser mis-read. It's in the "manual review" bin rather than rejected, which explains the blank field in the portal.
- The "Token expired or invalid" error looks like an expired invite link. We just generated a fresh portal invite token and sent it to procure_ops@crestline.com. Please try the new link from an incognito window (avoids stale cookies).

Attached is a short step-by-step we send to partners: redwood_coupa_onboard_steps.pdf. Two important items: complete the tax form verification step and confirm bank routing details under Payment Info — Coupa hides PO visibility until verification is complete for compliance reasons.

If the parsing still fails after you reupload, reply with the same file and I can trigger the manual verifier to accept the document (usually < 2 business hours). If you want us to manually unhide PO# 89123 while verification runs, I can request a one-off override.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_coupa_onboard_steps.pdf (application/pdf, 112 KB)

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@crestline.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, procure_ops@crestline.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00

Thanks Ben — I retried with the new invite link in incognito and the login works now. However the vendor profile still shows "Pending verification" and I still do not see PO# 89123. I reuploaded the same PDF and attached a screenshot of the portal state (coupa_pending_verification_screenshot.png).

Can you confirm you received the reupload and whether you can trigger the manual verifier? If a manual unhide for PO# 89123 is possible we would appreciate it — the goods team needs to acknowledge receipt by EOD Monday.

Forwarding the screenshot showing the pending state. If needed, we can provide the tax form as a signed DOCX instead for easier parsing.

Appreciate the quick help — please advise next steps and ETA.

Sarah
